Josh braves the Oregon coast to search for the real-life pirate treasure that inspired his all-time favorite movie; on the rocky shores of the Pacific, he finds pieces of a Spanish galleon that wrecked in 1694.

Josh Gates travels to the Holy Land to investigate a mystery of biblical proportions -- where was Jesus actually born? The investigation leads to explosive revelations that may change our understanding of Jesus' origin story.

S01 E09 — Fish to the Finish

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E05 — Factory of Death
A deserted facility in the remote countryside features mysterious graffiti that may be highly advanced mathematical equations pointing to a dark secret; experts investigate this classified military wasteland with a deadly past.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E05 — Altar Course
An officer catches a woman trying to use a forged visa to get into the U.S.; a rookie officer takes part in a cocaine seizure; officers suspect a traveler claiming to be a pastor on the way to a religious conference may not be who he says he is.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E06 — Dashing Through the Snow
Officers see a trend of narcotics being smuggled inside car dashboards; a teenager's tattoos send up red flags; a surprising load is found in a train car; a teenager attempting to cross the border is flagged as having an outstanding arrest warrant.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E10 — The Beetle's Live
A shipment of cardboard packing supplies hides a lethal secret, and a laptop computer bag conceals a narcotic that even advanced technology has trouble identifying; agriculture specialists prevent a deadly pest from entering the country.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E05 — A Rocky Family Vacation
After a K-9 alerts officers, a covert load of narcotics is found in the air tank of a tractor-trailer; a pair of pill smugglers are held to task; a Mexico-bound weapon cache is intercepted; a man is detained after a joint is found in his suitcase.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E08 — Tomato, Tomate
Officers discover a lethal load in the back seat of a car; 70-year-old sisters are caught trying to smuggle pain pills; a woman and son with fake visas attempt to cross into the US; officers assist a surgeon whose vehicle will only drive in reverse.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
You Put That Where?
As they pursue profit, drug cartels are constantly adapting -- hiding deadly narcotics where few would ever expect to find them.

title: Expedition X
description:
S08 E01 — The Madhouse
Josh, Phil and Heather investigate what may be the most haunted building in America: the Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum, where thousands died after disturbing medical procedures.

title: Expedition X
description:
S08 E02 — Trapped in the Asylum
Josh, Heather and Phil continue their investigation into a haunted lunatic asylum; they encounter extreme paranormal activity, capturing stunning evidence that convinces them this is their most terrifying expedition yet.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E01 — Secrets of Spike Island
Josh and Heather investigate Spike Island, Ireland's most brutal prison, after hearing paranormal claims from visitors and former inmates; have centuries of torture and death caused the island's spirits to finally break free?

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E02 — Ireland's Alcatraz
Josh and Heather continue their investigation into the history of Spike Island; their search uncovers the home of a notorious madman known as Dr. Death and leads them into tunnels lurking beneath the sprawling paranormal prison.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E05 — Spirits of 1776
As America marks its 250th birthday, reports of Revolutionary War ghosts draw Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne to historic battlefields in Pennsylvania. Their investigation uncovers unsettling encounters at some of the nation's most storied sites.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E03 — Curse of the Skinwalkers
A series of terrifying encounters in the Navajo Nation has renewed fears of the legendary Skinwalker. With the help of a local expert, Phil and Heather journey deep into a cursed valley and investigate a cave that few dare to enter.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E07 — Rocky Mountain Nugget Fever
The former Idaho Territory of Idaho and Montana is still rich with gold; Dave shows where and how everyday miners think outside the box to get it.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E08 — Montana Hard Rock Heaven
Dave Turin shows the small-time miners bringing in "gold hard cash" from Montana's hard rock; When a city slicker asks him to assess an old family mine, he goes on a mission and brings cool 21st-century tech to determine its riches.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E01 — Life, Liberty and Tax-free Liquor
Demand spikes for Tim and Tickle's duty-free shine, but big profits breed competition in the Virginia backwoods; Mark and Digger buy 90,000 bushels of surplus corn, but must run stills 24/7 to empty the grain silos in 60 days.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E02 — Stranger Danger
Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E03 — Mine and Shine
Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E04 — Digger Knows Best
Facing more demand for corn liquor than he can handle, Josh turns to Digger for help. Tim and Tickle discover their oddball neighbor is running an illegal moonshine operation of his own.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S05 E02 — Gold Today, Gone Tomorrow
When nuggets dry up on a couple's mine, the guys must crack the case, is it the miners or the mine?; battling a faulty operation, they build a new shaker table and a never-before-seen sluice scissor mechanism, making everything out of nothing.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S05 E01 — Pipe Dreams
Freddy and Juan face off at a hard rock mine spanning three elevations at 4,000 feet in the Cascades; battling impenetrable rock, the guys devise an innovative 180-foot chute featuring a spiral concentrator in their first Washington state rescue.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S05 E06 — Shake Rattle and Gold
A BC miner fights to set up a legacy mine for his son, located beside the gold-rich Fraser River; Freddy and Juan resurrect a boneyard shaker and Franken-build an entire wash plant to triple production, saving a father's dream.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E01 — Living Life on the Edge
A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E02 — The Tunnel of Chaos
The I-70 Eisenhower Tunnel closes in both directions as a 78-vehicle pileup creates mass chaos; Mountain Recovery and Stauffer's Towing battle high winds and slick roads to clear wreckage and keep major highways moving.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E01 — The Most Gold Wins
Parker and Tony set 13,000-ounce gold totals, sparking a battle to see who can mine the most and reigniting an old feud; Rick faces health issues and an uncertain future; a new player enters the Klondike fray.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E02 — A Midas Mess
Tony's crew sinks a bulldozer and two trucks in the Midas Cut while his grandson flirts with a rock truck driver; Parker pushes to get his second wash plant running; Buzz struggles to assemble a new plant.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E03 — Diagnosing Rick
Rick receives a life-altering diagnosis; Greenhorns push Tony to his breaking point; Parker fires up a third plant and gets surprising gold results.

title: Gold Rush
description:

Tony ambushes Rick with a secret offer. With high hopes, Parker's crew fires up a fourth plant in the Quagmire Cut. Buzz bets on White Channel pay.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:

Competing companies team up to recover a fully loaded cement truck leaking natural gas; Big Jon heads into avalanche country to rescue a stuck semi carrying hazardous goods; during a sudden blizzard, a crash in Salt Lake City leaves a semi in pieces.

Heavy Hitters Qualifying Group A Day One from Marion County, FL. Anglers compete to advance as well as to win the $30,000 Big Bass Bonus.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S03 E07 — Mysterious Endings
Did MKUltra's mind-control experiments spiral beyond the agency's grasp? Was Cleopatra's death truly by her own hand or a political assassination disguised as legend? Where did a painting worth $160 million disappear to without a trace?

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E01 — Mysteries of American History
Josh Gates explores American history, including a theory that John Wilkes Booth escaped justice -- only to meet a stranger fate; learn myth-busting truths behind Paul Revere's midnight ride and a U.S. Navy sub that vanished in the Cold War.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E07 — Truth Vs. Tabloids
Josh Gates investigates sensationalistic stories, seeking the truth behind the unexplained: rock legend Jim Morrison's death, a bizarre, preserved mermaid found in a Japanese temple, and claims of alien abduction from a U.S. Airman.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S02 E06 — Lost and Found
The true identity of infamous plane hijacker D.B. Cooper may finally be revealed; the fate of Michael Rockefeller, lost heir to the Rockefeller fortune, is exposed; the car in which James Dean died might not be missing anymore.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S02 E04 — Identity Crises
New evidence suggests the infamous Billy the Kid may have lived to old age under an assumed name; modern scholars explore the true identity of the "Man in the Iron Mask."

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E05 — All the Smoke or Going Broke
Matt must turn BBQ smokers into big bucks at a Texas-sized mess in Houston, Texas; at a second job, a massive termite infestation could eat the profits.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E02 — Hunting for Silver Bullets
Matt tackles a dangerous, ten-acre hoard in the Pennsylvania woods to hunt high-value guns and ammo; the old-school machinist's property is packed with heavy equipment and scrap metal, but $25,000 worth of precious metal could make a bet pay off.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E06 — Santa's Fury Road to Riches
Matt scrambles to clear a bat-infested barn and turn a sea of Santa Clauses into big money; while tackling jobs in Michigan and Massachusetts, Matt finds a lost cache of rare coins; a '64 Plymouth Fury could be a score if the owner decides to sell.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E12 — Treasure Hunting Reinvented
At a hoard Matt's been circling for years, a genius inventor's pinball and jukebox collection could bring big sales, but only if it's intact; removing a 1980s waterbed costs time and money.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E01 — Big Bangs for Big Bucks
Matt tackles a hoard packed with high-value vintage toys and hidden loaded guns; Matt test-drives a 1960s British sports car and test-fires the weapons at a local gun range; lowball bids force the team to find new buyers; total sales top $100,000.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:

Tizzy identifies a brazen shopper who places merchandise under his kilt; an angry golfer tees off on bystanders; a man has an ice cream truck meltdown; a woman claims a public beach as her own private yard.
